ZeroClaw shipped v0.7.5 on 2026-05-08 05:12 UTC and IronClaw shipped v0.28.0 on 2026-05-07 20:53 UTC, showing that the lighter-runtime and security-first critiques are both still shipping in parallel.

whyItMatters: This is a strong ecosystem-velocity day, not just a single-repo spike: the core reference, the learning-loop benchmark, the lightweight Rust lane, and the security-first lane all moved within roughly 24 hours.
Hermes shipping again matters strategically because it keeps the self-improving-agent story active as a live competitive pressure on OpenClaw, not just a conceptual adjacency.

Even with several releases, the higher-order read stays stable: the ecosystem is still organized around five durable pressures, namely core assistant depth, lightweight runtimes, stronger isolation, orchestration, and learning-loop or cloud-worker differentiation.
